_doc: Os dez textos definitivos aprovados da Daily Routine do Lukinhas (referência dos testes de integridade).

texts.L01: I usually wake up very early in the morning. First, I make my bed and go downstairs to feed my dog. I also clean up after him and take the rubbish out. Then, I have breakfast and take a shower. After that, I help around the house with some chores. At around eleven o'clock, I freshen up and go downstairs to watch TV with my brother. My dad lets us watch television until our school minibus arrives at about twelve forty.
texts.L02: My mornings start really early. As soon as I get up, I tidy my bed and head downstairs. I put some food in my dog's bowl and make sure everything is clean. Once I've looked after my dog, I have a good breakfast. Then, I head upstairs to take a shower. After getting dressed, I help my family with a few things around the house. Later on, my brother and I go downstairs to relax and watch TV while we wait for our school transport.
texts.L03: One of my first jobs every morning is looking after my dog. I get out of bed, make it properly and take his food downstairs. Once he's eaten, I clean up after him and sort out any mess. Then, I take the rubbish out and get ready for breakfast. After eating, I jump in the shower and help with the household chores. I always try to do my bit around the house before relaxing in the living room with my brother.
texts.L04: After breakfast, I don't just sit around doing nothing. I usually lend a hand with the housework. There are always little jobs to do, such as tidying things up, putting things away and keeping the house clean. Before that, I make sure my dog has been fed and his mess has been cleared away. Once I've finished my chores, I go upstairs to freshen up. Then, I head down to the living room and spend some time with my brother.
texts.L05: On a jiu-jitsu day, my morning is a little different. After waking up, making my bed and feeding the dog, I have breakfast and take a shower. I also help out with some chores before getting ready for training. At twenty to ten, my brother and I get changed into our jiu-jitsu clothes and head off to class. We get back home at eleven o'clock. Then, we put our dog's lead on and take him out for a walk until half past eleven.
texts.L06: When we get back from jiu-jitsu, it's time to take our dog out. We grab his lead, put it on him and head outside for a walk. We usually stay out for about half an hour. Once we get home, we take another shower and freshen up. After that, we make our way downstairs to the living room. My dad lets my brother and me kick back and watch some TV. It's a nice way to relax before the school minibus turns up.
texts.L07: My morning is quite busy, so I have to keep an eye on the time. I get up early, make my bed and go downstairs to feed the dog. After cleaning up after him, I take out the rubbish and have a filling breakfast. Then, I have a shower and get on with my chores. On training days, my brother and I leave at twenty to ten. We return at eleven, walk the dog for half an hour and get ready for the rest of the day.
texts.L08: I'm usually up bright and early. First things first, I sort out my dog's breakfast and clean up after him. Then, I get myself ready, have breakfast and pitch in with whatever needs doing around the house. If it's a jiu-jitsu day, my brother and I get our gear on and head out for training. When we come back, we take the dog for a walk. Later, we chill out in the living room and watch TV until our school ride shows up.
texts.L09: I like to get things done in the morning before it's time to go to school. I start by making my bed and taking care of my dog. Once I've fed him and cleaned up after him, I take the rubbish out and sit down for a proper breakfast. I then have a shower and crack on with my household chores. On training days, my brother and I head off to jiu-jitsu at twenty to ten. By half past eleven, we're back from walking the dog and ready to wind down.
texts.L10: My mornings are usually quite busy, but I've got a routine that helps me get everything done. I wake up early, make my bed and head downstairs to feed my dog. Once I've cleaned up after him and taken the rubbish out, I sit down for a hearty breakfast. After that, I jump in the shower and lend a hand with the household chores. On jiu-jitsu days, my brother and I get changed and head off to training at twenty to ten. We get back at eleven, put the dog's lead on and take him out for a walk. Once we're home again, we freshen up and head downstairs. My dad lets us kick back and watch TV until our school minibus pulls up at around twelve forty. And that's pretty much how I spend my morning!
